title: Replication package: Average Coverage Is Not Enough: A Facility-Level Audit of Conformal Prediction for Urban Parking-Occupancy Forecasting

creators.name: Abdelmagid, Mohamed
creators.affiliation: Khalifa University, Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates

description: Replication package: seven interval-forecasting methods on 49 parking facilities in two cities under a delay-aware protocol, with a two-level evaluation standard separating population-level from per-facility validity. Code MIT. Birmingham-derived data CC BY 4.0. Belgrade data are NOT redistributed for rights reasons; the acquisition route, schema and SHA-256 of every withheld file are provided. See DATA_AVAILABILITY.md.
